newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Pacific to supply Cortez with power.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Pacific to supply Cortez with power.

text.p: Sierra Pacific Power Co announced Monday a five-year contract to provide electricity and energy services to the Cortez Joint Venture gold mining operations in Crescent Valley, Nevada.
Sierra will supply up to 31 megawatts of electricity to the existing and future Cortez operations, which use electricity for mining, milling and heap leaching.
When the Cortez mines reach full capacity, energy usage is expected to represent more than 7 percent of Sierra Pacific's industrial load.
The utility estimates annual electric revenues from the operation at $12.8 million.
The contract, which is subject to approval by the Nevada Public Service Commission, is the utility's sixth long-term deal with major mining company.
The Cortez projects are a joint venture between Placer Dome U.S., and Kennecott Explorations.
